title: Start investing
tagline: A safety buffer first, then small monthly amounts that fit your profile. No jargon.
trigger: Savings growing well beyond a safety buffer, an end-of-year bonus, and no investments yet.

steps.title: Your safety buffer first
steps.description: About six months of spending stays in savings, so you never have to sell at a bad moment.
steps.why: Based on your own spending. Nothing is shared.
steps.result: Buffer of about €{buffer_k}k stays in your savings account.

steps.title: Your investor profile
steps.description: Five minutes of questions on your horizon and how you feel about ups and downs.
steps.why: The law requires it, and it keeps your investments matched to you.

steps.title: A monthly investment plan
steps.description: A fixed amount each month into a spread fund, with a responsible-investing option.
steps.why: Small and regular beats trying to time the market.
steps.result: Investment plan ready to start. About €{invest_k}k is above your buffer (illustrative).

steps.title: Invest your spare change
steps.description: Card payments rounded up, the difference invested. You won't notice it.
steps.why: An easy way to start before you feel ready.

steps.title: Prefer to choose yourself?
steps.description: Bolero, KBC's platform for buying shares and ETFs yourself.
steps.why: Bolero only receives your name, e-mail and investor profile.
steps.result: Bolero account ready, linked to your KBC account.
